picks.editorial_note: CERN signing with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated collider events is a landmark fusion of big science and frontier AI, with the potential to accelerate particle-physics discovery well beyond the LHC.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, unveiled at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, would link national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-science platform — a potentially transformative federal infrastructure play.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A claimed AI-generated analytic proof and formal verification of a finite-time singularity in the Navier-Stokes equations would be a historic result on one of math's hardest open problems, underscoring AI's growing role in frontier research.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced, 14+ university consortium to build shared advanced computing infrastructure signals serious federal and academic commitment to scaling AI research capacity regionally.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federally funded multi-institution effort to apply machine learning to protein misfolding could meaningfully advance understanding and treatment of neurodegenerative disease.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model dramatically speeds up prediction of protein motion compared to traditional molecular dynamics simulations, a tool with broad potential impact across structural biology and drug discovery.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: A $2.2 million Google.org grant to ANU for an AI-driven 'Cytotoxic Resistance Atlas' targets a major unsolved problem in oncology — why tumors resist chemotherapy — with direct clinical relevance.
picks.title: AI for science: Google.org funding to support ANU-led chemotherapy resistance cancer research

picks.editorial_note: A $1.6 million Google.org grant lets UCT build an AI platform mapping genetic variants in drug metabolism for African populations, addressing a long-standing equity gap in precision medicine research.
picks.title: Google grant boosts UCT's AI-driven scientific breakthroughs

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine learning tool for estimating radiation exposure from routine blood tests offers a fast, accessible alternative to specialized bioassays, with real-world value for emergency and occupational health response.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's EmArm brings human-like whole-arm tactile sensing to robotics via a soft optical skin and real-time decision algorithm, a meaningful step toward more dexterous, touch-aware embodied AI.
picks.title: HKUST Develops Embodied Robotic Arm “EmArm” with Human-Like Touch Sensing
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology
